title: Contract instantiation record
description: ADR-0022: the immutable origin record a contract names through `instantiated_from` — the exact template digest, the bound parameters, the filled inputs, the recorded eligibility outcomes, and the instantiated contract's identity. Instantiation is origin metadata, never a status; the pin is immutable and a later template revision does not touch it.

template.description: The exact template pin — the instance is checked against this revision, whatever newer revisions exist (CORE-A4801; a bound newer revision raises a `template_superseded` notice, CORE-A4806).

parameters.description: The bound value per declared parameter id — every required parameter must be bound, every bound name declared, every value inside its domain (CORE-A4802).

inputs.description: The contract input_ids the instance fills — must cover exactly the inputs the template declares (CORE-A4802).

eligibility.description: The recorded per-rule outcomes — the compiler re-derives them and refuses on a mismatch or a non-eligible rule (CORE-A4804).

aggregate.description: The recorded aggregate — must equal the aggregate the rules imply (CORE-A4804).

contract.description: The instantiated contract's identity — the digest must equal the canonical digest of the contract being compiled (CORE-A4801).
